verdict.rationale: Brex marketing explicitly advertises 'Unlock up to 3.70%†... cash back with a Brex business account,' indicating yield is earned directly within the Brex account rather than requiring a transfer to another institution. However, there is no documentation on the underlying mechanism (e.g., sweep networks, money-market fund partners) or independent verification of the yield claim. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how yield is generated/held, third-party/independent confirmation of the rate and terms, and any finance-lead-specific guidance on managing operating cash for yield.
